# Line coverage floors (percent) for the code that makes decisions, checked by CI's coverage
# job (.github/scripts/coverage.py). Raise a floor when coverage rises; never lower one to let
# a change through. Hardware, FFI and GUI code is reported but has no floor.
#
# Each floor sits about 2 points under what CI measured (in brackets, 2026-11-20), so
# moving a few lines in a refactor passes and dropping a test does not. A floor set from a
# measurement outside CI (marked "local") sits about 5 under it: local runs have read about
# 2.5 points above CI's. Raise it once CI's number is known.

src/service/monitor.rs 72     # (74.4) the rest is the run() loop: threads and real time

src/service/flight.rs 91      # (93.3)

src/service/sag.rs 93         # (95.2) daily history and the creep warning included

src/sensor/detect.rs 86       # (87.9) the sensor scan: safety rule 1's decisions
